storage.description: Storage driver to add: local (UPLOAD_DIR) or s3 (S3 / MinIO, adds a minio service to docker-compose). Default: the one installed before, else local

thumbnails.description: Generate a small webp thumbnail next to every image with sharp (and fill width/height)

force.description: Overwrite generated files that you have edited

root.description: Project directory relative to the current directory (used by `new --apps`)
